title: Status bar usage bar preferences

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Menu Bar Label, Icon Style, Show Pace Markers, Accent Color, and Use Default controls must update status-bar presentation settings.
Preference settings must appear in deterministic menu projection and validation snapshot evidence.
Presentation preference actions must not mutate the account catalog, active-account ID, or auth-file bytes.

targetSurface: CodexPill status bar settings, AppKit menu projection, hosted validation snapshot, and coordinator preference actions

nonClaims: Does not open the live NSColorPanel color chooser.
Does not prove native menu-bar clicks, live screen capture, or native hittability.
Does not use or prove behavior against real account/auth data.
